en: A multi‑view vintage postcard with the caption "SOUVENIR DI CORFU" showing several small colored views of Corfu, including a classical statue, a harbor panorama with ships, a grand neoclassical building, a garden with palm trees and statues, and a large public building on a square. Decorative flowers are placed among the views, and a watermark with the URL "www.elia.org.gr" appears at the bottom.
